title: Stealthy, High-Impact False Data Injection Attacks in Smart Grid Using Physics-Constrained GAN with Limited System Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2611.15162v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: False data injection (FDI) attacks can distort power system state estimation while retaining plausible measurement patterns. Existing FDI methods trade stealth for impact or vice versa. They often assume access to internal grids, all-bus sensing, or defender models. In this paper, we propose a detector-agnostic physics-constrained generative adversarial network (PCGAN) that learns decoupled power-flow sensitivities from historical measurements of deployed sensors. The learned active-power-angle and reactive-power-voltage-magnitude relationships guide perturbations restricted to compromised channels, while adversarial training promotes realistic spatiotemporal patterns. We implement PCGAN and seven existing FDI attacks on the IEEE 300-bus system using one year of observed hourly demand from PJM Interconnection, a regional transmission organization in the United States, and synthetic bus-level load profiles. translated_title: 基于物理约束生成对抗网络且仅需有限系统知识的智能电网隐蔽高影响虚假数据注入攻击
translated_abstract: 虚假数据注入（FDI）攻击能够在保持看似合理的量测模式的同时扭曲电力系统状态估计。现有的FDI方法往往在隐蔽性与攻击影响之间进行权衡，并且通常假设攻击者能够访问电网内部信息、全部母线量测或防御者模型。本文提出一种与检测器无关的物理约束生成对抗网络（PCGAN），它能够从已部署传感器的历史量测数据中学习解耦的潮流灵敏度。学习到的有功-相角与无功-电压幅值关系用于引导仅限于被攻陷通道的扰动，同时对抗训练促使攻击数据呈现真实的时空模式。我们在IEEE 300节点系统上，利用美国区域输电组织PJM互联公司一年的实测小时需求数据以及合成的母线级负荷曲线，实现了PCGAN及七种现有的FDI攻击，并对它们的性能进行了比较……
tldr: 该论文提出一种仅需有限系统知识、与检测器无关的物理约束生成对抗网络（PCGAN），通过从历史量测中学习解耦的潮流灵敏度，生成兼顾隐蔽性与高影响的智能电网虚假数据注入攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a detector-agnostic physics-constrained GAN (PCGAN) requiring limited system knowledge, which learns decoupled power-flow sensitivities from historical measurements to generate stealthy yet high-impact false data injection attacks in smart grids.
